title: Effectiveness of Nutri-grade Labelling System on Lowered Consumption of High-sugar and Saturated Fats Pre-packaged Foods
what_it_is: Effectiveness of Nutri-grade Labelling System on Lowered Consumption of High-sugar and Saturated Fats Pre-packaged Foods

sections.label: Nutri-Grade sugar and sodium measures
sections.summary: Highest-sugar and saturated-fat beverages are graded D and banned from advertising, and Nutri-Grade will extend to sodium and saturated fat products from mid-2027.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Beverages containing the highest levels of sugar and saturated fat are graded "D" and are subject to advertising prohibitions across all media platforms.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The median sugar level of pre-packaged beverages has decreased from 7.1% in 2017 to 4.6% in 2023, and the average daily sugar intake of residents has fallen from 60 grammes in 2018 to 56 grammes in 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: To reduce sodium intake and further reduce saturated fat consumption, Nutri-Grade measures will be extended to key contributors of sodium and saturated fat intake sold in the retail setting from mid-2027.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Similarly, advertisements promoting the sale of products including prepacked salt, sauces, seasonings, instant noodles and cooking oil that are graded "D" will be prohibited.
